architecture.anchor_note: The College and Career Readiness anchor standards are the cross-grade backbone: each grade-specific standard is a grade-appropriate articulation of one anchor. Modelled once, in ../skills/practices/.

strands_6_12.name: Reading in Science and Technical Subjects (literacy strand)
Writing in History/Social Studies, Science and Technical Subjects (literacy strand)

architecture.strand_notes: Reading: Foundational Skills (RF) exists only in K-5. The literacy strands RH, RST and WHST exist only in 6-12 and are addressed to history/social-studies, science and technical teachers rather than to the ELA teacher.
architecture.identifier_grammar: CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.<strand><grade>.<number>, e.g. CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RL.4.3; grade bands appear as written, e.g. CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RI.9-10.1; literacy strands carry their own prefix, e.g. CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.RST.6-8.3.
